highlights: ✨ 3D Shapes: stand shapes up from the ground in Mode 7 as panels, boxes or floating objects, with per-type 3D looks and character collision (#1358, #1362, #1367, #1368).
✨ Croupier: play turn-based croupier games on the board with table and seat shapes — no game server needed (#1338).
✨ Character: multi-jump and hover, a jump button for touch controls via setVirtualInput, and sprites that stand up in 3D views (#1300, #1350, #1382).
✨ Free Draw: hosts can add their own pens and read the current pen / color / width, and stroke ends can snap to nearby strokes of the same pen (#1364, #1379, #1384).
⚡️ Perf: drag, hover and presence updates no longer rescan every shape or redraw idle overlays across snap, select, connectors, presence and more (#1305, #1309, #1322, #1333, #1334).
✨ Live Sessions: server-authoritative voting with mid-join, reconnect grace, host handoff and secret ballots — a framework you extend with your own session types (#924).
✨ New packages: @edv4h/usketch-plugin-session (framework) + @edv4h/usketch-session-voting (first event type). Old @edv4h/usketch-plugin-voting is deprecated (#924).
✨ Map: public tool-state stores (toolStateStore / MAP_MODES / useMapToolState) so hosts can drive the map tool from custom UIs (#927).
✨ Sync: new MSG_SESSION channel (sendSession / onSession) for server-processed session messages (#924).
✨ AI Copilot: ghost shapes stream in as you sketch.
✨ AI Voice: NL2Canvas — 「不作成の矩形を主要エリアに」で初期配置を生成.
✨ Presentation mode now supports laser pointer and spotlight overlays.
♻️ Refactored sync layer: awareness events moved to EventBus.
🐛 Fix: sticky note z‑order regressed after group ungrouping.
🐛 Fix: connector reroute missed when the attached shape rotated.
⚡️ Perf: QuadTree rebuild deferred to idle callback — ~40% faster first‑paint.
✨ TransientRegistry: ephemeral objects (cursors, ripples, ghosts) get their own lifecycle.
✨ Shape Island plugin — soft regions grouping shapes by proximity.
📚 Docs: every concept page now has a live example inline.
🎉 Initial stable release of the plugin‑first rewrite (#565).
✨ Real‑time collab with Yjs + Cloudflare Durable Objects.
✨ 50+ first‑party plugins ship with the reference app.
